name: getAccess
description: Lists the access rights of one or more projects, named by the repeated project parameter.

name: getAccounts
description: Queries accounts visible to the caller. The query is given by the query parameter; use limit and start to page and o to request extra fields.

name: getAccountsAccountId
description: Returns the details of one account as an AccountInfo entity.

name: putAccountsAccountId
description: Creates a new account.

username.description: The user name. If provided, must match the user name from the URL.

name.description: The full name of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

ssh_key.description: The public SSH key of the user.

http_password.description: The HTTP password of the user. (deprecated)

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

tokens.description: A list of tokens in the form of AuthTokenInputs to assign to the user.

groups.description: A list of group IDs that identify the groups to which the user should be added.

name: deleteAccountsAccountId
description: Deletes the given account if config enableDelete under accounts section is enabled.

name: getAccountsAccountIdActive
description: Checks if an account is active.

name: putAccountsAccountIdActive
description: Sets the account state to active.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdActive
description: Sets the account state to inactive.

name: getAccountsAccountIdAgreements
description: Gets a list of the user's signed contributor agreements.

name: putAccountsAccountIdAgreements
description: Signs a contributor agreement.

name.description: The name of the agreement.

name: getAccountsAccountIdAvatar
description: Retrieves the avatar image of the user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdAvatarChangeUrl
description: Retrieves the URL where the user can change the avatar image.

name: getAccountsAccountIdCapabilities
description: Returns the global capabilities that are enabled for the specified user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdCapabilitiesCapabilityId
description: Checks if a user has a certain global capability.

name: getAccountsAccountIdDetail
description: Retrieves the details of an account as an AccountDetailInfo entity.

name: putAccountsAccountIdDisplayname
description: The new display name must be provided in the request body inside a DisplayNameInput entity.

display_name.description: The new display name of the account.

name: postAccountsAccountIdDraftsDelete
description: Deletes some or all of a user's draft comments. The set of comments to delete is specified as a DeleteDraftCommentsInput entity. An empty input entity deletes all comments.

query.description: A change query limiting results to changes matching this query; has:draft is implied and not necessary to list explicitly. If not set, matches all changes with drafts.

name: getAccountsAccountIdEmails
description: Returns the email addresses that are configured for the specified user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdEmailsEmailId
description: Retrieves an email address of a user.

name: putAccountsAccountIdEmailsEmailId
description: Registers a new email address for the user. A verification email is sent with a link that needs to be visited to confirm the email address, unless DEVELOPMENT_BECOME_ANY_ACCOUNT is used as authentication type. For the development mode email addresses are directly added without confirmation.

email.description: The email address. If provided, must match the email address from the URL.

preferred.description: Whether the new email address should become the preferred email address of the user (only supported if no_confirmation is set or if the authentication type is DEVELOPMENT_BECOME_ANY_ACCOUNT).

no_confirmation.description: Whether the email address should be added without confirmation. In this case no verification email is sent to the user. + Only Gerrit administrators are allowed to add email addresses without confirmation.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdEmailsEmailId
description: Deletes an email address of an account.

name: putAccountsAccountIdEmailsEmailIdAvatar
description: Sets an email address as the avatar email address for an account. The avatar email address is used for avatar lookup, e.g. via Gravatar.

name: putAccountsAccountIdEmailsEmailIdPreferred
description: Sets an email address as preferred email address for an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdExternalIds
description: Retrieves the external ids of a user account.

name: postAccountsAccountIdExternalIdsDelete
description: Delete a list of external ids for a user account. The target external ids must be provided as a list in the request body.

name: getAccountsAccountIdGpgkeys
description: Returns the GPG keys of an account.

name: postAccountsAccountIdGpgkeys
description: Add or delete one or more GPG keys for a user.

add.description: List of ASCII armored public key strings to add.

name: getAccountsAccountIdGpgkeysGpgKeyId
description: Retrieves a GPG key of a user.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdGpgkeysGpgKeyId
description: Deletes a GPG key of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdGroups
description: Lists all groups that contain the specified user as a member.

name: postAccountsAccountIdIndex
description: Adds or updates the account in the secondary index.

name: getAccountsAccountIdName
description: Retrieves the full name of an account.

name: putAccountsAccountIdName
description: Sets the full name of an account.

name.description: The new full name of the account. + If not set or if set to an empty string, the account name is deleted.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdName
description: Deletes the name of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdOauthtoken
description: Returns a previously obtained OAuth access token.

name: putAccountsAccountIdPasswordHttp
description: Sets/Generates an authentication token with id legacy for an account.

http_password.description: The new HTTP password. Only Gerrit administrators may set the HTTP password directly. + If empty or not set and generate is false or not set, the HTTP password is deleted.

generate.description: Whether a new HTTP password should be generated

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdPasswordHttp
description: Deletes the token with id legacy of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdPreferences
description: Retrieves the user's preferences.

name: putAccountsAccountIdPreferences
description: Sets the user's preferences.

changes_per_page.description: The number of changes to show on each page. Allowed values are 10, 25, 50, 100.

download_scheme.description: The type of download URL the user prefers to use. May be any key from the schemes map in DownloadInfo.

theme.description: Which theme to use. Allowed values are AUTO or DARK or LIGHT.

date_format.description: The format to display the date in. Allowed values are STD, US, ISO, EURO, UK.

time_format.description: The format to display the time in. Allowed values are HHMM_12, HHMM_24.

expand_inline_diffs.description: Whether to expand diffs inline instead of opening as separate page (Gerrit web app UI only).

relative_date_in_change_table.description: Whether to show relative dates in the changes table.

diff_view.description: The type of diff view to show. Allowed values are SIDE_BY_SIDE, UNIFIED_DIFF.

size_bar_in_change_table.description: Whether to show the change sizes as colored bars in the change table.

legacycid_in_change_table.description: Whether to show change number in the change table.

mute_common_path_prefixes.description: Whether to mute common path prefixes in file names in the file table.

signed_off_by.description: Whether to insert Signed-off-by footer in changes created with the inline edit feature.

email_strategy.description: The type of email strategy to use. On ENABLED, the user will receive emails from Gerrit. On CC_ON_OWN_COMMENTS the user will also receive emails for their own comments. On ATTENTION_SET_ONLY, on emails about changes, the user will receive emails only if they are in the attention set of that change.

email_format.description: The format to use for outgoing email. Allowed values are PLAINTEXT and HTML_PLAINTEXT.

default_base_for_merges.description: The base which should be pre-selected in the 'Diff Against' drop-down list when the change screen is opened for a merge commit. Allowed values are AUTO_MERGE and FIRST_PARENT.

publish_comments_on_push.description: Whether to publish draft comments on push by default.

disable_keyboard_shortcuts.description: Whether to disable all keyboard shortcuts.

disable_token_highlighting.description: Whether to disable token highlighting on hover.

work_in_progress_by_default.description: Whether to set work-in-progress on push or on create changes online by default.

url.description: The URL of the menu item link.

name.description: The name of the menu item.

target.description: Target attribute of the menu item link.

id.description: The id attribute of the menu item link.

my.description: The menu items of the MY top menu as a list of TopMenuItemInfo entities.

change_table.description: The columns to display in the change table (Gerrit web app UI only). The default is empty, which will default columns as determined by the frontend.

allow_browser_notifications.description: Whether to prompt user to enable browser notification in browser.

allow_suggest_code_while_commenting.description: Whether to receive suggested code while writing comments. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

allow_autocompleting_comments.description: Whether to receive autocompletions while writing comments. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

ai_chat_selected_model.description: The name of the AI model selected for the AI chat. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

label_filter.description: A comma-separated list of label names that limits which label columns are shown in the change table. If empty, all labels are shown.

diff_page_sidebar.description: String indicating which sidebar should be open on the diff page. Set to "NONE" if no sidebars should be open. Plugin-supplied sidebars will be prefixed with "plugin-".

name: getAccountsAccountIdPreferencesDiff
description: Retrieves the diff preferences of a user.

name: putAccountsAccountIdPreferencesDiff
description: Sets the diff preferences of a user.

context.description: The number of lines of context when viewing a patch.

tab_size.description: Number of spaces that should be used to display one tab.

font_size.description: Default font size in pixels for change to be displayed in the diff view.

line_length.description: Number of characters that should be displayed in one line.

cursor_blink_rate.description: Half-period in milliseconds used for cursor blinking. Setting it to 0 disables cursor blinking.

expand_all_comments.description: Whether all inline comments should be automatically expanded.

intraline_difference.description: Whether intraline differences should be highlighted.

manual_review.description: Whether the 'Reviewed' flag should not be set automatically on a patch when it is viewed.

show_line_endings.description: Whether Windows EOL/Cr-Lf should be displayed as '\r' in a dotted-line box.

show_whitespace_errors.description: Whether whitespace errors should be shown.

syntax_highlighting.description: Whether syntax highlighting should be enabled.

hide_top_menu.description: If true the top menu header and site header are hidden.

auto_hide_diff_table_header.description: If true the diff table header is automatically hidden when scrolling down more than half of a page.

hide_line_numbers.description: If true the line numbers are hidden.

render_entire_file.description: Whether the whole file should be rendered instead of only the changed parts.

hide_empty_pane.description: Whether empty panes should be hidden. The left pane is empty when a file was added; the right pane is empty when a file was deleted.

match_brackets.description: Whether matching brackets should be highlighted.

line_wrapping.description: Whether to enable line wrapping or not.

responsive_mode.description: The responsive-rendering mode of the diff view. Allowed values are NONE, SHRINK_ONLY and FULL_RESPONSIVE.

ignore_whitespace.description: Whether whitespace changes should be ignored and if yes, which whitespace changes should be ignored. + Allowed values are IGNORE_NONE, IGNORE_TRAILING, IGNORE_LEADING_AND_TRAILING, IGNORE_ALL.

retain_header.description: Whether the header that is displayed above the patch (that either shows the commit message, the diff preferences, the patch sets or the files) should be retained on file switch.

skip_deleted.description: Whether deleted files should be skipped on file switch.

skip_unchanged.description: Whether files without changes are skipped when switching between files.

skip_uncommented.description: Whether uncommented files should be skipped on file switch.

name: getAccountsAccountIdPreferencesEdit
description: Retrieves the edit preferences of a user.

name: putAccountsAccountIdPreferencesEdit
description: Sets the edit preferences of a user.

tab_size.description: Number of spaces that should be used to display one tab.

line_length.description: Number of characters that should be displayed per line.

indent_unit.description: Number of spaces that should be used for auto-indent.

cursor_blink_rate.description: Half-period in milliseconds used for cursor blinking. Setting it to 0 disables cursor blinking.

hide_top_menu.description: If true the top menu header and site header is hidden.

show_whitespace_errors.description: Whether whitespace errors should be shown.

syntax_highlighting.description: Whether syntax highlighting should be enabled.

hide_line_numbers.description: Whether line numbers should be hidden.

match_brackets.description: Whether matching brackets should be highlighted.

line_wrapping.description: Whether to enable line wrapping or not.

indent_with_tabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs or not.

auto_close_brackets.description: Whether brackets and quotes should be auto-closed during typing.

show_base.description: Whether to show the inline edit base version or not.

name: getAccountsAccountIdSshkeys
description: Returns the SSH keys of an account.

name: postAccountsAccountIdSshkeys
description: Adds an SSH key for a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdSshkeysSshKeyId
description: Retrieves an SSH key of a user.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdSshkeysSshKeyId
description: Deletes an SSH key of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdStarredChanges
description: Gets the changes that were starred with the default star by the identified user account.

name: putAccountsAccountIdStarredChangesStarredChangeId
description: Star a change with the default label. Changes starred with the default label are returned for the search query is:starred or has:star and automatically notify the user whenever updates are made to the change.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdStarredChangesStarredChangeId
description: Remove the default star label from a change. This stops notifications.

name: getAccountsAccountIdState
description: Retrieves the superset of all information related to an account. This information is useful to inspect issues with the account and its permissions. The account state is returned as an AccountStateInfo entity.

name: getAccountsAccountIdStatus
description: Retrieves the status of an account.

name: putAccountsAccountIdStatus
description: Sets the status of an account.

status.description: The new status of the account. + If not set or if set to an empty string, the account status is deleted.

name: getAccountsAccountIdTokens
description: Lists the token ids of an account as a list of AuthTokenInfos. The plain text token will never be returned.

name: putAccountsAccountIdTokensTokenId
description: Creates a new token for an account. The token is usually generated. Administrators can also set a specific token for an account.

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

name: deleteAccountsAccountIdTokensTokenId
description: Deletes the token with the given token-id of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdUsername
description: Retrieves the username of an account.

name: putAccountsAccountIdUsername
description: The new username must be provided in the request body inside a UsernameInput entity.

username.description: The new username of the account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdWatchedProjects
description: Retrieves all projects a user is watching.

name: postAccountsAccountIdWatchedProjects
description: Add new projects to watch or update existing watched projects. Projects that are already watched by a user will be updated with the provided configuration. All other projects in the request will be watched using the provided configuration. The posted body can contain ProjectWatchInfo entities. Omitted boolean values will be set to false.

filter.description: A filter string to be applied to the project.

problem.description: An error message when project is for example hidden or deleted.

name: postAccountsAccountIdWatchedProjectsDelete
description: Projects posted to this endpoint will no longer be watched. The posted body can contain a list of ProjectWatchInfo entities.

filter.description: A filter string to be applied to the project.

problem.description: An error message when project is for example hidden or deleted.

name: getChanges
description: Queries changes visible to the caller. The query is given by the repeatable query parameter; use limit/start to page and o to request extra fields.

name: postChanges
description: Creates a new change from a ChangeInput entity.

branch.description: The name of the target branch. + The refs/heads/ prefix is omitted.

subject.description: The commit message of the change. Comment lines (beginning with #) will be removed. If the commit message contains a Change-Id (as a "Change-Id: I..." footer) that Change-Id will be used for the newly created changed.

topic.description: The topic to which this change belongs. Topic can't contain quotation marks.

status.description: The status of the change (only NEW accepted here).

is_private.description: Whether the new change should be marked as private.

work_in_progress.description: Whether the new change should be set to work in progress.

base_change.description: A \{change-id\} that identifies the base change for a create change operation. + Mutually exclusive with base_commit. + If neither base_commit nor base_change are set, the target branch tip will be used as the parent commit.

base_commit.description: A 40-digit hex SHA-1 of the commit which will be the parent commit of the newly created change. If set, it must be a merged commit on the destination branch. + Mutually exclusive with base_change.

new_branch.description: Allow creating a new branch when set to true. Using this option is only possible for non-merge commits (if the merge field is not set).

validation_options.description: Map with key-value pairs that are forwarded as options to the commit validation listeners (e.g. can be used to skip certain validations). Which validation options are supported depends on the installed commit validation listeners.

custom_keyed_values.description: Custom keyed values as a map from custom keys to values.

source.description: The source to merge from, e.g. a complete or abbreviated commit SHA-1, a complete reference name, a short reference name under refs/heads, refs/tags, or refs/remotes namespace, etc.

source_branch.description: A branch from which source is reachable. If specified, source is checked for visibility and reachability against only this branch. This speeds up the operation, especially for large repos with many branches.

strategy.description: The strategy of the merge, can be recursive, resolve, simple-two-way-in-core, ours or theirs, default will use project settings.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, creating the merge succeeds also if there are conflicts. + If there are conflicts the file contents of the created change contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts.

merge.description: The detail of a merge commit as a MergeInput entity. If set, the target branch (see branch field) must exist (it is not possible to create it automatically by setting the new_branch field to true.

patch.description: The patch to be applied. Must be compatible with git diff output. For example, Get Patch output. The patch must be provided as UTF-8 text, either directly or base64-encoded.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, tolerate conflicts and add conflict markers where required.

patch.description: The detail of a patch to be applied as an ApplyPatchInput entity.

username.description: The user name. If provided, must match the user name from the URL.

name.description: The full name of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

ssh_key.description: The public SSH key of the user.

http_password.description: The HTTP password of the user. (deprecated)

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

tokens.description: A list of tokens in the form of AuthTokenInputs to assign to the user.

groups.description: A list of group IDs that identify the groups to which the user should be added.

author.description: The author of the commit to create. Must be an AccountInput entity with at least the name and email fields set. The caller needs "Forge Author" permission when using this field. This field does not affect the owner of the change, which will continue to use the identity of the caller.

response_format_options.description: List of query options to format the response.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change is created. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is OWNER for WIP changes and ALL otherwise.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the change creation as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeId
description: Retrieves a single change as a ChangeInfo entity; request additional data with the o parameter.

name: deleteChangesChangeId
description: Deletes a change.

name: postChangesChangeIdAbandon
description: Abandons a change; an optional message is posted as a change message.

message.description: Message to be added as review comment to the change when abandoning the change.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change is abandoned. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdAttention
description: Returns all users that are currently in the attention set. As response a list of AttentionSetInfo entity is returned.

name: postChangesChangeIdAttention
description: Adds a single user to the attention set of a change.

user.description: ID of the account that should be added to the attention set. For removals, this field should be empty or the same as the field in the request header.

reason.description: The reason of for adding or removing the user.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change is created. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is OWNER.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the change creation as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdAttentionAttentionSetEntryId
description: 'POST /changes/\{change-id\}/attention/\{account-id\}/delete' --

name: postChangesChangeIdAttentionAttentionSetEntryIdDelete
description: Deletes a single user from the attention set of a change.

user.description: ID of the account that should be added to the attention set. For removals, this field should be empty or the same as the field in the request header.

reason.description: The reason of for adding or removing the user.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change is created. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is OWNER.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the change creation as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdCheck
description: Performs consistency checks on the change, and returns a ChangeInfo entity with the problems field set to a list of ProblemInfo entities.

name: postChangesChangeIdCheck
description: Performs consistency checks on the change as with GET /check, and additionally fixes any problems that can be fixed automatically. The returned field values reflect any fixes.

delete_patch_set_if_commit_missing.description: If true, delete patch sets from the database if they refer to missing commit options.

expect_merged_as.description: If set, check that the change is merged into the destination branch as this exact SHA-1. If not, insert a new patch set referring to this commit.

name: postChangesChangeIdCheckSubmitRequirement
description: Tests a submit requirement and returns the result as a SubmitRequirementResultInfo.

name.description: The submit requirement name.

applicability_expression.description: Query expression that can be evaluated on any change. If evaluated to true on a change, the submit requirement is then applicable for this change. If not specified, the submit requirement is applicable for all changes.

submittability_expression.description: Query expression that can be evaluated on any change. If evaluated to true on a change, the submit requirement is fulfilled and not blocking change submission.

override_expression.description: Query expression that can be evaluated on any change. If evaluated to true on a change, the submit requirement is overridden and not blocking change submission.

allow_override_in_child_projects.description: Whether this submit requirement can be overridden in child projects. Default is true.

name: getChangesChangeIdComments
description: Lists the published comments of all revisions of a change, grouped by file path.

name: getChangesChangeIdCustomKeyedValues
description: Gets the custom keyed values associated with a change.

name: postChangesChangeIdCustomKeyedValues
description: Adds and/or removes custom keyed values from a change.

add.description: The map of custom keyed values to be added to the change.

remove.description: The list of custom keys to be removed from the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdDetail
description: Retrieves a change with labels, detailed labels, detailed accounts, reviewer updates, and messages.

name: getChangesChangeIdDrafts
description: Lists the draft comments of all revisions of the change that belong to the calling user.

name: getChangesChangeIdEdit
description: Retrieves the change edit of the calling user, if one exists, as an EditInfo entity.

name: postChangesChangeIdEdit
description: Creates empty change edit, restores file content or renames files in change edit. The request body needs to include a ChangeEditInput entity when a file within change edit should be restored or old and new file names to rename a file.

old_path.description: Old path to file to rename.

new_path.description: New path to file to rename.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdEdit
description: Deletes change edit.

name: getChangesChangeIdEditChangeEditId
description: Retrieves content of a file from a change edit.

name: putChangesChangeIdEditChangeEditId
description: Put content of a file to a change edit.

content.description: The new content of the file, sent as the raw request body. If not set, an empty file is created or the existing content is cleared.

binary_content.description: The file content as a base-64 encoded data URI. If no content is provided, an empty is created or if an existing file is updated the file content is removed so that the file becomes empty. The content must be a SHA1 if the file mode is 160000 (gitlink).

file_mode.description: The file mode in octal format. Supported values are 100644 (regular file), 100755 (executable file), 120000 (symlink) and 160000 (gitlink). If unset, new files are created with file mode 100644 (regular file) and for existing files the existing file mode is kept.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdEditChangeEditId
description: Deletes a file from a change edit. This deletes the file from the repository completely. This is not the same as reverting or restoring a file to its previous contents.

name: getChangesChangeIdEditChangeEditIdMeta
description: Retrieves meta data of a file from a change edit. Currently only web links are returned.

name: putChangesChangeIdEditIdentity
description: Modify author or committer identity. The request body needs to include a ChangeEditIdentityInput entity. Either name or email must be provided. type must be either AUTHOR or COMMITTER.

name.description: The name of the author/committer. If not specified, the existing name will be used.

email.description: The email of the author/committer. If not specified, the existing email will be used.

type.description: Type of the identity being edited. Must be either AUTHOR or COMMITTER.

name: getChangesChangeIdEditMessage
description: Retrieves commit message from change edit.

name: putChangesChangeIdEditMessage
description: Modify commit message. The request body needs to include a ChangeEditMessageInput entity.

name: postChangesChangeIdEditPublish
description: Promotes change edit to a regular patch set.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change edit is published. + Allowed values are NONE and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

name: postChangesChangeIdEditRebase
description: Rebases change edit on top of latest patch set.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, the rebase also succeeds if there are conflicts. + If there are conflicts the file contents of the rebased patch set contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts.

name: getChangesChangeIdFlows
description: Lists the flows of a change that are visible to the caller.

name: postChangesChangeIdFlows
description: Creates a flow on the change.

condition.description: The condition which must be satisfied for the action to be triggered. Can contain multiple conditions separated by comma. The syntax of the condition depends on the flow service implementation.

name.description: The name of the action. Which actions are supported depends on the flow service implementation.

parameters.description: Parameters for the action as list of strings. Which parameters are supported and their format depends on the flow service implementation.

action.description: The action that should be triggered when the condition is satisfied as a FlowActionInfo entity.

stage_expressions.description: The expressions for the stages of the flow (sorted by execution order) as a list of FlowExpressionInfo entities.

name: getChangesChangeIdFlowsActions
description: Lists the flows actions that are configured for the given change.

name: getChangesChangeIdFlowsFlowId
description: Gets a flow on the change.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdFlowsFlowId
description: Delete a flow on the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdHashtags
description: Gets the hashtags associated with a change.

name: postChangesChangeIdHashtags
description: Adds and/or removes hashtags from a change.

add.description: The list of hashtags to be added to the change.

remove.description: The list of hashtags to be removed from the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdIn
description: Retrieves the branches and tags in which a change is included. As result an IncludedInInfo entity is returned.

name: postChangesChangeIdIndex
description: Adds or updates the change in the secondary index.

name: getChangesChangeIdIsFlowsEnabled
description: Returns whether flows are enabled for this change.

name: postChangesChangeIdMerge
description: Update an existing change by using a MergePatchSetInput entity.

subject.description: The new subject for the change, if not specified, will reuse the current patch set's subject

inherit_parent.description: Use the current patch set's first parent as the merge tip when set to true.

base_change.description: A \{change-id\} that identifies a change. When inherit_parent is false, the merge tip will be the current patch set of the base_change if it's set. Otherwise, the current branch tip of the destination branch will be used.

source.description: The source to merge from, e.g. a complete or abbreviated commit SHA-1, a complete reference name, a short reference name under refs/heads, refs/tags, or refs/remotes namespace, etc.

source_branch.description: A branch from which source is reachable. If specified, source is checked for visibility and reachability against only this branch. This speeds up the operation, especially for large repos with many branches.

strategy.description: The strategy of the merge, can be recursive, resolve, simple-two-way-in-core, ours or theirs, default will use project settings.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, creating the merge succeeds also if there are conflicts. + If there are conflicts the file contents of the created change contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts.

merge.description: The detail of the source commit for merge as a MergeInput entity.

username.description: The user name. If provided, must match the user name from the URL.

name.description: The full name of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

ssh_key.description: The public SSH key of the user.

http_password.description: The HTTP password of the user. (deprecated)

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

tokens.description: A list of tokens in the form of AuthTokenInputs to assign to the user.

groups.description: A list of group IDs that identify the groups to which the user should be added.

author.description: The author of the commit to create. Must be an AccountInput entity with at least the name and email fields set. The caller needs "Forge Author" permission when using this field. This field does not affect the owner or the committer of the change, which will continue to use the identity of the caller.

validation_options.description: Map with key-value pairs that are forwarded as options to the commit validation listeners (e.g. can be used to skip certain validations). Which validation options are supported depends on the installed commit validation listeners.

name: getChangesChangeIdMessage
description: Returns the commit message of the change (from the current patch set).

name: putChangesChangeIdMessage
description: Creates a new patch set with a new commit message.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the commit message was updated. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is OWNER for WIP changes and ALL otherwise.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

committer_email.description: New message is committed using this email address. Only the registered emails of the calling user are considered valid.

name: getChangesChangeIdMessages
description: Lists the messages of a change as ChangeMessageInfo entities.

name: getChangesChangeIdMessagesChangeMessageId
description: As response a ChangeMessageInfo entity is returned.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdMessagesChangeMessageId
description: 'POST /changes/\{change-id\}/messages/\{change-message-id\}/delete' --

name: postChangesChangeIdMessagesChangeMessageIdDelete
description: Deletes a change message by replacing the change message with a new message, which contains the name of the user who deleted the change message and the reason why it was deleted. The reason can be provided in the request body as a DeleteChangeMessageInput entity.

reason.description: The reason why the change message should be deleted. + If set, the change message will be replaced with "Change message removed by: name\nReason: reason", or just "Change message removed by: name." if not set.

name: getChangesChangeIdMetaDiff
description: Retrieves the difference between two historical states of a change by specifying the old=SHA-1 and the meta=SHA-1 parameters.

name: postChangesChangeIdMove
description: Moves a change to another branch, given by a MoveInput entity.

message.description: A message to be posted in this change's comments

keep_all_votes.description: By default, only veto votes that are blocking the change from submission are moved to the destination branch. Using this option is only allowed for administrators, because it can affect the submission behaviour of the change (depending on the label access configuration and submissions rules).

name: postChangesChangeIdPatchApply
description: Creates a new patch set on a destination change from the provided patch.

patch.description: The patch to be applied. Must be compatible with git diff output. For example, Get Patch output. The patch must be provided as UTF-8 text, either directly or base64-encoded.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, tolerate conflicts and add conflict markers where required.

patch.description: The details of the patch to be applied as a ApplyPatchInput entity.

commit_message.description: The commit message for the new patch set. If not specified, the latest patch-set message will be used.

base.description: 40-hex digit SHA-1 of the commit which will be the parent commit of the newly created patch set. If set, it must be a merged commit or a change revision on the destination branch. Otherwise, the target change's branch tip will be used.

username.description: The user name. If provided, must match the user name from the URL.

name.description: The full name of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

ssh_key.description: The public SSH key of the user.

http_password.description: The HTTP password of the user. (deprecated)

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

tokens.description: A list of tokens in the form of AuthTokenInputs to assign to the user.

groups.description: A list of group IDs that identify the groups to which the user should be added.

author.description: The author of the commit to create. Must be an AccountInput entity with at least the name and email fields set. The caller needs "Forge Author" permission when using this field, unless specifies their own details.

response_format_options.description: List of query options to format the response.

amend.description: If true, the revision from the URL will be amended by the patch. This will use the tree of the revision, apply the patch and create a new commit whose tree is the resulting tree of the operation and whose parent(s) are the parent(s) of the revision. Cannot be used together with base.

name: postChangesChangeIdPrivate
description: Marks the change to be private. Only open changes can be marked private. Changes may only be marked private by the owner or site administrators.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdPrivate
description: Marks the change to be non-private. Note users can only unmark own private changes.

name: postChangesChangeIdPrivateDelete
description: Marks the change to be non-private. Note users can only unmark own private changes.

name: getChangesChangeIdPureRevert
description: Check if the given change is a pure revert of the change it references in revertOf. Optionally, the query parameter o can be passed in to specify a commit (SHA-1 in 40 digit hex representation) to check against. It takes precedence over revertOf. If the change has no reference in revertOf, the parameter is mandatory.

name: getChangesChangeIdQuery
description: Evaluates whether the given change query expression matches the change.

name: postChangesChangeIdReady
description: Marks the change as ready for review (set WIP property to false). Changes may only be marked ready by the owner, project owners or site administrators.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change is set to WorkInProgress/ReadyForReview. Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL.

message.description: Message to be added as a review comment to the change being set WorkInProgress/ReadyForReview.

name: postChangesChangeIdRebase
description: Rebases a change onto a new base, given by a RebaseInput entity.

base.description: The new parent revision. This can be a ref or a SHA-1 to a concrete patchset. + Alternatively, a change number can be specified, in which case the current patch set is inferred.

strategy.description: The strategy of the merge, can be recursive, resolve, simple-two-way-in-core, ours or theirs, default will use project settings.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, the rebase also succeeds if there are conflicts. + If there are conflicts the file contents of the rebased patch set contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts.

on_behalf_of_uploader.description: If true, the rebase is done on behalf of the uploader. + This means the uploader of the current patch set will also be the uploader of the rebased patch set. The calling user will be recorded as the real user. + Rebasing on behalf of the uploader is only supported for trivial rebases.

validation_options.description: Map with key-value pairs that are forwarded as options to the commit validation listeners (e.g. can be used to skip certain validations). Which validation options are supported depends on the installed commit validation listeners.

committer_email.description: Rebase is committed using this email address. Only the registered emails of the calling user or uploader (when on_behalf_of_uploader is true) are considered valid. This option is not supported when rebasing a chain.

name: postChangesChangeIdRebaseChain

name: postChangesChangeIdRestore
description: Restores an abandoned change.

message.description: Message to be added as review comment to the change when restoring the change.

name: postChangesChangeIdRevert
description: Reverts a change.

message.description: Commit message of the revert commit. If not specified, a default commit message is set.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent for reverting the change. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the revert as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

topic.description: Name of the topic for the revert change. If not set, the default for Revert endpoint is the topic of the change being reverted, and the default for the RevertSubmission endpoint is revert-{submission_id}-{timestamp.now}. Topic can't contain quotation marks.

work_in_progress.description: When present, change is marked as Work In Progress. The notify input is used if it's present, otherwise it will be overridden to NONE. + Notifications for the reverted change will only sent once the result change is no longer WIP. + If not set, the default is false.

validation_options.description: Map with key-value pairs that are forwarded as options to the commit validation listeners (e.g. can be used to skip certain validations). Which validation options are supported depends on the installed commit validation listeners.

name: postChangesChangeIdRevertSubmission
description: Creates open revert changes for all of the changes of a certain submission.

message.description: Commit message of the revert commit. If not specified, a default commit message is set.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent for reverting the change. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the revert as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

topic.description: Name of the topic for the revert change. If not set, the default for Revert endpoint is the topic of the change being reverted, and the default for the RevertSubmission endpoint is revert-{submission_id}-{timestamp.now}. Topic can't contain quotation marks.

work_in_progress.description: When present, change is marked as Work In Progress. The notify input is used if it's present, otherwise it will be overridden to NONE. + Notifications for the reverted change will only sent once the result change is no longer WIP. + If not set, the default is false.

name: getChangesChangeIdReviewers
description: Lists the reviewers of a change as ReviewerInfo entities.

name: postChangesChangeIdReviewers
description: Adds one user or all members of one group as reviewer to the change.

reviewer.description: The ID of one account that should be added/removed as reviewer or the ID of one internal group for which all members should be added as reviewers. + If an ID identifies both an account and a group, only the account is added as reviewer to the change.

confirmed.description: Whether adding the reviewer is confirmed. + The Gerrit server may be configured to require a confirmation when adding a group as reviewer that has many members.

state.description: Add reviewer in this state. Possible reviewer states are REVIEWER, CC and REMOVED. If not given, defaults to REVIEWER.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the reviewer is added. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

on_behalf_of.description: \{account-id\} the reviewer should be added on behalf of. To use this option the caller must have been granted RUN_AS permission. + If not set, the default is the caller.

name: getChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerId
description: Retrieves a reviewer of a change.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerId
description: 'POST /changes/\{change-id\}/reviewers/\{account-id\}/delete' --

name: postChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerIdDelete
description: Deletes a reviewer from a change. Deleting a reviewer also removes that user from the attention set.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the reviewer is deleted. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerIdVotes
description: Lists the votes for a specific reviewer of the change.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerIdVotesVoteId
description: 'POST /changes/\{change-id\}/reviewers/\{account-id\}/votes/\{label-id\}/delete' --

name: postChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerIdVotesVoteIdDelete
description: Deletes a single vote from a change. Note, that even when the last vote of a reviewer is removed the reviewer itself is still listed on the change.

label.description: The label for which the vote should be deleted. + If set, must match the label in the URL.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the vote is deleted. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

ignore_automatic_attention_set_rules.description: If set to true, ignore all automatic attention set rules described in the attention set. When not set, the default is false.

reason.description: The reason why this vote is deleted. Will + go into the change message.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionId
description: Retrieves a revision of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdActions
description: Retrieves revision actions of the revision of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdArchive
description: Retrieves an archive of the files in a revision.

name: postChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCherrypick
description: Cherry-picks a revision to a destination branch, given by a CherryPickInput entity.

message.description: Commit message for the cherry-pick change. If not set, the commit message of the cherry-picked commit is used.

base.description: 40-hex digit SHA-1 of the commit which will be the parent commit of the newly created change. If set, it must be a merged commit or a change revision on the destination branch.

parent.description: Number of the parent relative to which the cherry-pick should be considered.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the cherry-pick. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is ALL.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the update as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.

keep_reviewers.description: If true, carries reviewers and ccs over from original change to newly created one.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, the cherry-pick uses content merge and succeeds also if there are conflicts. If there are conflicts the file contents of the created change contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts.

topic.description: The topic of the created cherry-picked change. If not set, the default depends on the source. If the source is a change with a topic, the resulting topic of the cherry-picked change will be {source_change_topic}-{destination_branch}.

allow_empty.description: If true, the cherry-pick succeeds also if the created commit will be empty. If false, a cherry-pick that would create an empty commit fails without creating the commit.

validation_options.description: Map with key-value pairs that are forwarded as options to the commit validation listeners (e.g. can be used to skip certain validations). Which validation options are supported depends on the installed commit validation listeners.

committer_email.description: Cherry-pick is committed using this email address. Only the registered emails of the calling user are considered valid. Defaults to source commit's committer email if it is a registered email of the calling user, else defaults to calling user's preferred email.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdComments
description: Lists the published comments of a revision, grouped by file path.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCommentsCommentId
description: Retrieves a published comment of a revision.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCommentsCommentI
description: 'POST /changes/\{change-id\}/revisions/\{revision-id\}/comments/\{comment-id\}/delete' --

name: postChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCommentsCommentIdD
description: Deletes a published comment of a revision. Instead of deleting the whole comment, this endpoint just replaces the comment's message with a new message, which contains the name of the user who deletes the comment and the reason why it's deleted.

reason.description: The reason why the comment should be deleted. + If set, the comment's message will be replaced with "Comment removed by: name; Reason: reason", or just "Comment removed by: name." if not set.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCommit
description: Retrieves the commit of a revision as a CommitInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDescription
description: Retrieves the description of a patch set.

name: putChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDescription
description: Sets the description of a patch set.

name: putChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDrafts
description: Creates a draft comment on a revision.

tag.description: Value of the tag field from ReviewInput set while posting the review. NOTE: To apply different tags on different votes/comments multiple invocations of the REST call are required.

unresolved.description: Whether or not the comment must be addressed by the user. The state of resolution of a comment thread is stored in the last comment in that thread chronologically.

patch_set.description: The patch set number for the comment; only set in contexts where + comments may be returned for multiple patch sets.

id.description: The URL encoded UUID of the comment.

path.description: The file path for which the inline comment was done. + Not set if returned in a map where the key is the file path.

side.description: The side on which the comment was added. + Allowed values are REVISION and PARENT. + If not set, the default is REVISION.

parent.description: The 1-based parent number. Used only for merge commits when side == PARENT. When not set the comment is for the auto-merge tree.

line.description: The number of the line for which the comment was done. + If range is set, this equals the end line of the range. + If neither line nor range is set, it's a file comment.

start_line.description: The start line number of the range. (1-based)

start_character.description: The character position in the start line. (0-based)

end_line.description: The end line number of the range. (1-based)

end_character.description: The character position in the end line. (0-based)

range.description: The range of the comment as a CommentRange entity.

in_reply_to.description: The URL encoded UUID of the comment to which this comment is a reply.

updated.description: The timestamp of when this comment was written.

commit_id.description: Hex commit SHA-1 (40 characters string) of the commit of the patchset to which this comment applies.

fix_id.description: The UUID of the suggested fix. It will be generated automatically and hence will be ignored if it's set for input objects.

description.description: A description of the suggested fix.

path.description: The path of the file which should be modified. Any file in the repository may be modified. The commit message can be modified via the magic file /COMMIT_MSG though only the part below the generated header of that magic file can be modified.

start_line.description: The start line number of the range. (1-based)

start_character.description: The character position in the start line. (0-based)

end_line.description: The end line number of the range. (1-based)

end_character.description: The character position in the end line. (0-based)

range.description: A CommentRange indicating which content of the file should be replaced. Lines in the file are assumed to be separated by the line feed character.

replacement.description: The content which should be used instead of the current one.

replacements.description: A list of FixReplacementInfo entities indicating how the content of one or several files should be modified. Within a file, they should refer to non-overlapping regions.

fix_suggestions.description: Suggested fixes for this comment as a list of FixSuggestionInfo entities.

is_ai.description: Whether the comment was created by an AI agent. Not set if false.

name: deleteChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDraftsDraftComme
description: Deletes a draft comment from a revision.

description: Lists the files that were added, modified, or deleted in a revision.

work_in_progress.description: Whether the new change should be set to work in progress.

base_commit.description: A 40-digit hex SHA-1 of the commit which will be the parent commit of the newly created change. If set, it must be a merged commit on the destination branch. + Mutually exclusive with base_change.

new_branch.description: Allow creating a new branch when set to true. Using this option is only possible for non-merge commits (if the merge field is not set).

validation_options.description: Map with key-value pairs that are forwarded as options to the commit validation listeners (e.g. can be used to skip certain validations). Which validation options are supported depends on the installed commit validation listeners.

custom_keyed_values.description: Custom keyed values as a map from custom keys to values.

source.description: The source to merge from, e.g. a complete or abbreviated commit SHA-1, a complete reference name, a short reference name under refs/heads, refs/tags, or refs/remotes namespace, etc.

source_branch.description: A branch from which source is reachable. If specified, source is checked for visibility and reachability against only this branch. This speeds up the operation, especially for large repos with many branches.

strategy.description: The strategy of the merge, can be recursive, resolve, simple-two-way-in-core, ours or theirs, default will use project settings.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, creating the merge succeeds also if there are conflicts. + If there are conflicts the file contents of the created change contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts.

merge.description: The detail of a merge commit as a MergeInput entity. If set, the target branch (see branch field) must exist (it is not possible to create it automatically by setting the new_branch field to true.

patch.description: The patch to be applied. Must be compatible with git diff output. For example, Get Patch output. The patch must be provided as UTF-8 text, either directly or base64-encoded.

allow_conflicts.description: If true, tolerate conflicts and add conflict markers where required.

patch.description: The detail of a patch to be applied as an ApplyPatchInput entity.

username.description: The user name. If provided, must match the user name from the URL.

name.description: The full name of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

ssh_key.description: The public SSH key of the user.

http_password.description: The HTTP password of the user. (deprecated)

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

tokens.description: A list of tokens in the form of AuthTokenInputs to assign to the user.

groups.description: A list of group IDs that identify the groups to which the user should be added.

author.description: The author of the commit to create. Must be an AccountInput entity with at least the name and email fields set. The caller needs "Forge Author" permission when using this field. This field does not affect the owner of the change, which will continue to use the identity of the caller.

response_format_options.description: List of query options to format the response.

notify.description: Notify handling that defines to whom email notifications should be sent after the change is created. + Allowed values are NONE, OWNER, OWNER_REVIEWERS and ALL. + If not set, the default is OWNER for WIP changes and ALL otherwise.

accounts.description: A list of account IDs that identify the accounts that should be notified.

notify_details.description: Additional information about whom to notify about the change creation as a map of recipient type to NotifyInfo entity.
